source: AFH 33-337 Ch. 5 (pp. 47-51) & Ch. 7 (pp. 74-89), plus DoDI 5200.48 / DAFI 16-1403 CUI Registry guidance and De-AI plain-language checks.

logical_fallacies.name: Asserted Conclusion
logical_fallacies.definition: Slipping an assertion in as a fact via circular restatement or loaded questions.
logical_fallacies.fix: Prove the underlying claim with independent evidence.

logical_fallacies.name: Character Attack
logical_fallacies.definition: Attacking an opponent's person or motive instead of their argument.
logical_fallacies.fix: Address the evidence and merit of the proposal.

logical_fallacies.name: Emotional Appeals
logical_fallacies.definition: Replacing reasoned argument with fear, sympathy, peer pressure, or 'we have always done it this way'.
logical_fallacies.fix: Pair mission values with concrete facts and operational impact.

logical_fallacies.name: False Authority
logical_fallacies.definition: Citing someone with rank/fame outside their expertise, or believing a claim solely because it is printed.
logical_fallacies.fix: Verify primary data and subject-matter credentials.

logical_fallacies.name: False Cause
logical_fallacies.definition: Assuming Event A caused Event B merely because A preceded B.
logical_fallacies.fix: Rule out third factors (Event C) and establish mechanism.

logical_fallacies.name: Single Cause
logical_fallacies.definition: Blaming one factor when multiple causes drive an outcome.
logical_fallacies.fix: Account for contributing variables and weigh primary drivers.

logical_fallacies.name: Faulty Analogy
logical_fallacies.definition: Claiming two things alike in one minor trait behave identically in the way that matters.
logical_fallacies.fix: Verify critical structural similarities or use direct evidence.

logical_fallacies.name: Faulty Dilemma
logical_fallacies.definition: Framing an issue as only two extreme options when middle-ground COAs exist.
logical_fallacies.fix: Present all realistic courses of action.

logical_fallacies.name: Hasty Generalization
logical_fallacies.definition: Jumping to a broad conclusion from too few or unrepresentative examples.
logical_fallacies.fix: Gather representative, sufficient data across affected units.

logical_fallacies.name: Non Sequitur
logical_fallacies.definition: Conclusion does not logically follow from the premises (e.g., technical skill automatically equals command ability).
logical_fallacies.fix: Add the missing logical warrant linking evidence to claim.

logical_fallacies.name: Slippery Slope
logical_fallacies.definition: Asserting one small step inevitably triggers an uncontrollable extreme cascade.
logical_fallacies.fix: Identify enforceable policy gates rather than assuming inevitability.

logical_fallacies.name: Red Herring
logical_fallacies.definition: Introducing irrelevant information to distract from the actual decision point.
logical_fallacies.fix: Cut off-topic trivia and return to the PURPOSE statement.

logical_fallacies.name: Stacked Evidence
logical_fallacies.definition: Withholding counterarguments or contradictory data to push a preferred option.
logical_fallacies.fix: Address risks and counterarguments openly in VIEWS OF OTHERS / DISCUSSION.

logical_fallacies.name: Straw Man
logical_fallacies.definition: Attacking a weakened distortion of an opposing COA rather than the real argument.
logical_fallacies.fix: State opposing COAs accurately before rebutting them.

CTI.name: Controlled Technical Information
CTI.note: Commonly paired with a DoD Distribution Statement (B-F).

EXPT.name: Export Controlled
EXPT.note: ITAR/EAR technical data; use SP-EXPT when Specified handling required.

OPSEC.name: Operations Security
OPSEC.note: Protects critical mission indicators and vulnerabilities.

cui_ldcs.FED ONLY: Dissemination limited to U.S. Government executive branch employees, armed forces, and Active Guard/Reserve.
cui_ldcs.FEDCON: Dissemination limited to federal employees/military plus U.S. Government contractors performing a contractual purpose.
cui_ldcs.NOCON: No dissemination to contractors (federal, state, local, or tribal government employees only).
cui_ldcs.DL ONLY: Dissemination restricted exclusively to entities on the accompanying Dissemination List.
cui_ldcs.NOFORN: No dissemination to foreign governments, nationals, or international organizations (strictly regulated).
cui_ldcs.REL TO: Releasable to specified countries/coalitions (e.g., REL TO USA, FVEY) after foreign disclosure approval.
cui_ldcs.None: No Limited Dissemination Control; anyone with a lawful government purpose may access (not cleared for public release).

cui_distribution_statements.A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited (cannot be combined with CUI).
cui_distribution_statements.B: Distribution authorized to U.S. Government agencies only.
cui_distribution_statements.C: Distribution authorized to U.S. Government agencies and their contractors.
cui_distribution_statements.D: Distribution authorized to Department of Defense / War and U.S. DoD/DoW contractors only.
cui_distribution_statements.E: Distribution authorized to DoD/DoW Components only.
cui_distribution_statements.F: Further dissemination only as directed by the controlling office or higher authority.
